port.label: Port
port.description: The page is served on this loopback port. Set another one to run beside gm-web, which serves 6111 by default, and open http://127.0.0.1:<port>/.

fuse.label: Snapshot before a command
fuse.description: Take a snapshot of the saves before the first command is run, and reuse it. /fuse takes one on demand either way.

fuseMinutes.label: Reuse a snapshot for
fuseMinutes.description: How long one snapshot serves the commands that follow it, so a queue of twenty commands writes one file instead of twenty. 0 snapshots before every command.

keep.label: Snapshots to keep
keep.description: Older snapshots are removed beyond this many. Each one is about 1.8 MB.
